notes.dimension_status: Body values preserve the adopted 7U40 nominal design; all fit/adhesive/slot/lid/knob values remain prototype choices.
notes.wall_semantics: wall is retained flat material thickness, not the offset from metal. Same thickness on outer skirt, roof and inner return.
notes.fit_semantics: fit_per_face + adhesive_per_face is nominal empty space on VERTICAL bonding faces only. Roof underside and bottom flange top are hard metal-contact datums (zero vertical gap). The 0.15 adhesive allocation is not a chosen tape thickness: the final adhesive/tape+filler must bridge the full actual gap; dry-fit is the present trial. Do not claim side retention tested.
notes.lid_seat: No gasket is assumed. Top guard rests directly on metal Z=91 at its roof underside. Lid bearing underside equals the actual top of that guard. No floating vertical fit gap.
notes.cut_edges: Factory cut metal edges still require deburring. Small split gaps are not a safety certification.
notes.support: Body plate dimensions, 8mm rail spacers, lift-off concept, and transport straps are unchanged. No lid-to-body lock.
